blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Actor Dennis Trillo’s seemingly simple post about his favorite bag has drawn attention online amid the renewed discussions surrounding his wife, actress Jennylyn Mercado, and her ex-boyfriend, actor Patrick Garcia. Trillo recently shared a photo of his favorite red tote bag on Facebook, describing it as lightweight and versatile. “Oh ikaw, ano ang bag mo??” he asked his followers. (How about you? What is your bag?)
